scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0135; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Core remember dialogue is grammatical and natural; A09-A14 reuse previously taught natural targets: This information is for you; My mind is full of questions; It was two days ago; We can talk after class; That guy is Sam; This is my hand.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian prompts for the six spaced-retrieval items preserve the previously taught meanings and contain no unsupported contextual claims.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Existing English choice distractors remain grammatical, natural and explicitly audited; the added retrieval activities contain no distractors.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The lesson keeps one new A1 target and adds short, already-learned retrieval items rather than introducing new meanings.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: Current target transfer remains intact, while A09-A14 independently reactivate prior targets within the policy window.

overallCoherence.evidence: New material is labeled and structured as spaced review, so it does not alter the main remember outcome or story semantics.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No added activity claims an image, photo, visual, or listening source. Existing listening/reconstruction tasks point only to audioRequired turns exposed earlier by A02.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the recall-from-memory sense of remember is assessed as new content.
The six added spaced-retrieval prompts are model/editor reviewed but not learner-tested.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Runtime behavior still requires CI validation.
